name: Function Overload
descriptionTemplate: If the consumed Arithmetica is even, deal [Damage:Arg2] DMG X+2 times. Otherwise, Gain [Block:Arg3] Shield X+1 times.
lore:
The device on Erica's waist is her power source, a complex mechanism operating on incomprehensible principles, continuously supplying her with the necessary electric current.
Like its owner, the device is extremely unstable and releases a massive burst of energy when she shorts out, with visible electrical currents shooting in all directions, burning everything around.

patch.descriptionTemplate: If the consumed Arithmetica is even, deal [Damage:Arg2] DMG X+2 times. Otherwise, gain [Block:Arg3] Shield X+1 times. {Leap}: Both effects are active simultaneously.
